definitions.explanation: a person who is skilled at speaking, storytelling, or engaging others in conversation

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{話|はな}し{上手|じょうず}だ。
{話|はな}し{上手|じょうず}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{聞|き}き{上手|じょうず}→聞き上手：08468_kikijouzu⟧で⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: People who are good at talking are often good listeners too.

examples.japanese: ⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧で⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{話|はな}し{上手|じょうず}⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Being a good communicator is important for sales work.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
⟦{話|はな}し→話す：00467_hanasu⟧ (talking) + ⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧ (skilled at)

NA-ADJECTIVE USE:
{話|はな}し{上手|じょうず}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ - a person who's good at talking

RELATED ～{上手|じょうず} PATTERNS:
- ⟦{聞|き}き{上手|じょうず}→聞き上手：08468_kikijouzu⟧ - good listener
- ⟦{甘|あま}え{上手|じょうず}→甘え上手：08495_amaejouzu⟧ - good at being spoiled/pampered
- ⟦{世渡|よわた}り{上手|じょうず}→世渡り上手：08496_yowatarijouzu⟧ - socially savvy
- {褒|ほ}め⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧ - good at giving compliments

USAGE:
In Japanese communication culture, being a good listener (⟦{聞|き}き{上手|じょうず}→聞き上手：08468_kikijouzu⟧) is often valued as much as or more than being a good speaker.
